_comment: Audit F006 — collected tests that run in NO per-PR CI job. SHRINK-ONLY, enforced by scripts/audit/check_test_marker_coverage.py (a stale entry that has become non-orphaned FAILS the gate). Reduced 38 -> 17 -> 11 on 2026-07-14: the 6 'integration_under_unit' entries were resolved — 3 dead skip-only tests (2 lifetime-metrics placeholders + 1 superseded gmail rate-limit test) were DELETED, and the 3 real message-pagination cursor tests now run in the integration PR job via its cross-root `-m integration` collection over tests/unit + tests/agents (proven against real PostgreSQL). The remaining 11 are all legitimately-periodic infra tests.

categories.on_demand_infra: e2e / benchmark / multiprocess / perf — infra-sensitive and slow, deliberately excluded from per-PR jobs by their markers and run on demand via 'task test:backend:slow'. Legitimately out-of-PR; not a debt to erase.
